name: build-personal-brand
description:
Guides the user through building a professional personal brand from strategy
definition through audience growth, chaining 5 atomic skills across
career-development and writing categories. Covers platform selection, content
format, niche vs. broad positioning, and B2B vs. B2C audience targeting. Use
when the user wants to build professional visibility, establish thought
leadership, or grow an audience around their expertise. Do NOT use for
launching a product-based business (use a business workflow), job searching
(use land-new-job workflow), or building a creative portfolio (use
launch-art-portfolio workflow).
